title: About GitHub Copilot coding agent
relevance_note: About GitHub Copilot coding agent is a official doc source with details on sandboxed execution environment, internet egress firewall relevant to policy program.
reason_included: Included for source-local evidence on policy program, tool gateway, verification.

claim_snippets.claim_text: Copilot coding agent can only create and push to branches beginning with `copilot/` and cannot push to `main` or `master`.
GitHub filters hidden characters before passing user input to Copilot coding agent (e.g., HTML comments in issues/PR comments are not passed).
Copilot coding agent works in a sandbox development environment with internet access controlled by a firewall and has read-only access to the repository it is assigned to work in.
By default, GitHub Actions workflows are not triggered for Copilot coding agent pull requests until a user with write access clicks an approval to run workflows (optional auto-run can be configured).
